retrievalProfile.description: A square photographic composition framed by a thick off-white border, featuring centered serif typography over a soft-focus, low-contrast sepia image.
triggerTerms: sepia square photo with wide border
excludeWhen: high-contrast black and white is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square photograph in muted sepia tones, depicting a figure in a reclined, vulnerable pose amidst soft bedding, surrounded by a thick, uniform off-white border with a single line of centered serif text in the upper third of the image area.
coreVisualRelationships: Square image nested within a larger square canvas
Text positioned in the upper third of the photographic frame
Low-contrast sepia palette across the entire image area
Soft, diffused lighting creating a hazy atmosphere
coreInvariants: Thick, uniform off-white border surrounding the central square image

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is a reclined figure occupying the lower two-thirds of the central square, scaled to feel intimate and close-up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central square photograph acts as the primary anchor, with the text serving as a secondary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the centered text, moves down to the subject's face and hands, and then follows the curves of the bedding.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space is provided by the wide outer border and the soft, uncluttered background of the photo.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a compressed value range, avoiding pure blacks or harsh whites.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for minimalist impact.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the classical, elegant serif structure.
Provides the necessary old-style serif feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square photograph in muted sepia tones featuring a soft-focus, reclined figure on bedding, then place this square inside a larger off-white square frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, uppercase serif text in the upper third of the inner square using a light-colored font with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the image a square within a square?
Is the color palette strictly sepia and off-white?
Is the text centered and in an uppercase serif font?
Is the lighting soft and diffused?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is perfectly centered horizontally
Verify the sepia tone is consistent across the inner image
Confirm the font has visible serifs and wide tracking
recipe.reuseFormula: Square central photo + wide off-white border + centered uppercase serif text = Minimalist Editorial Aesthetic
